text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: p99 latency > 3s for 5m on inference-api-prod. Alert group: latency.slo.p99. Pager: @eng-oncall. PD incident: PD-98321.

alex.oncall: ACKing. I'm on rotation, joining now. Anyone see a recent model rollout?

dmitri.sre: seeing elevated tail across us-west and eu-west. Traffic looks normal, but node CPU on gpu-sidecar nodes bumped ~30% 6m ago.

maya.eng: we pushed a small model variant rollout ~8m ago (v2-small-quant). Rolling back canary now.

jordan.eng: starting rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-canary --namespace=prod`

alex.oncall: good. Also throttling large batch routes for now: set `max_batch_tokens=1024` on route /generate (patching config).

sam.ops: autoscaler did not add nodes — hitting quota cap for the pool. Requesting emergency burst to 5 nodes from infra (cc @infra).

dmitri.sre: warming KV cache might help. Triggering prefix warm for top 10 keys (script: `scripts/warm_kv.sh top-10`).

maya.eng: rollback complete, canary -> previous stable (v2-stable). Observability: p99 dropping in eu-west, still high in us-west.

alex.oncall: any sign of errors/timeouts at customer-facing proxy?

jordan.eng: a small fraction (~0.6%) of requests returned 504 from edge during the 6m window. Logs show queue time spiked.

nina.pm: customer reports: one large e-comm partner saw slower checkout autocomplete for ~10 minutes. No revenue impact reported, but degraded UX. If this persists >30m we'll need a status page update.

sam.ops: infra granted temporary burst to 3 extra nodes, autoscaler now able to scale.

dmitri.sre: after scaling + rollback + KV warm, p99 now trending down to ~2.1s in eu-west and 2.9s in us-west. Still watching.

alex.oncall: moving to mitigation phase. Next steps: keep batch throttle for 15m, monitor p95/p99 and error rate. If p99 >3s again, escalate to @eng-platform and PD escalation.

incident-bot: Note: incident-bot added tag `mitigating` and updated PD-98321.

nina.pm: noted. I'll prepare a customer-facing blurb in case we need it: brief explanation + ETA.

alex.oncall: Thanks team :thumbsup:. I'll handoff at 20:40 UTC to the next rotation with current state: p99 ~2.5s, reduced errors, mitigations applied.

jordan.eng: leaving monitoring checks running, will post if we see any regression.

alex.oncall: last check-in before handoff: p99=2.4s, p95=0.48s, error rate 0.15%. Handoff to @dmitri.sre for overnight watch.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active response; will reopen if alert returns.
